summary: Klinger Oscillator: the 34-bar EMA minus the 55-bar EMA of volume force, with a 13-bar signal line.
overview: The Klinger Oscillator, by Stephen Klinger, compares long-term and short-term volume flow, in its own pane. It has an oscillator line and a signal line in orange.
Colors are green while the oscillator is above its signal and red while below.
how: Trend = +1 when typical price (high + low + close) is higher than the previous bar, -1 when lower. Volume force uses volume, trend and the bar's range. KO = EMA(volume force, 34) - EMA(volume force, 55). Signal = EMA(KO, 13).
use: Some traders watch KO crossing its signal line.
Use zero-line crosses as long-term flow changes.
Look for divergence between KO and price.
Use it with a trend filter to read crosses in context.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: It needs volume data; on symbols without volume it shows nothing useful.
The volume force also uses a running sum of bar ranges that resets when the trend flips.
